name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/avatar';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: ComponentProps<typeof AvatarPrimitive.Fallback> = $props();
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Fallback
  bind:ref
  class={cn(
    'flex size-full items-center justify-center rounded-[inherit] bg-secondary text-xs',
    className
  )}
  data-slot="avatar-fallback"
  {...restProps}
></AvatarPrimitive.Fallback>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/avatar';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: ComponentProps<typeof AvatarPrimitive.Image> = $props();
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Image
  bind:ref
  class={cn('aspect-square size-full object-cover', className)}
  data-slot="avatar-image"
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/avatar';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    size = 'default',
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: ComponentProps<typeof AvatarPrimitive.Root> & {
    size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg';
  } = $props();
</script>

<AvatarPrimitive.Root
  bind:ref
  data-slot="avatar"
  data-size={size}
  class={cn('relative flex size-8 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-full', className)}
  {...restProps}
/>
